scope: three separate same-mesh two-phase contrasts on frozen homogeneous-reference crack states S0, S1, S2, plus one alternative S2 band mesh; direct phase effect only; no crack advance, no State 3, no CZM, no onset, no toughness

states.adapter: crackPolyline = [mouth; X3(physicalTipNode)], tipTangent = (0,1); saved upperBankT6/lowerBankT6 used as is and verified
none (saved schema already carries crackPolyline, tipTangent, banks, anchors)

states.pr35Regression: H1, M0, Msoft, Mstiff u, EDI, COD, compliance, CMOD and the ratio table must equal PR #35 run C exactly

alternativeMeshS2.changesVersusOriginal: band and guide-face size 1.5 -> 1.0 mm (76 -> about 112 interface chords), exterior Hmax 6 -> 5 mm; crack, p010 kernel, collar, rim, hole edges, tip guide unchanged
alternativeMeshS2.gates: join pass, independent 34/34, T3 <= 40000, min angle >= 20 deg, ratio <= 1.8, full phase map + verifier + negatives, H1 = M0 identity, all SIF gates

robustnessClassification.ROBUST: same sign of R-1 and |dR_alt - dR_orig| <= 0.10 |dR_orig| for that contrast
robustnessClassification.HOLD: alternative mesh or any gate fails; then no refinement-qualified statement

phaseMap: unchanged from G2_MATERIAL_POLICY_v1.json phaseMap block (tolerances 1e-9 mm, gap 1e-3 mm, area 1e-12, plate area 1e-9, q clearance >= 1 mm, tip guide 15 mm matrix only)

crossStateComparability.geometryEquivalentIf: equal chord count per circle and per-band polygon area within 1e-4 relative of the S2 value
crossStateComparability.otherwise: label the cross-state trend GEOMETRY-CONFOUNDED; per-state results stay valid as same-mesh contrasts

regressions.S0_original: g2_t6_elasticity + g2_sif_interaction (five annuli, 6x6) + g2_sif_cod (geometric faces) must reproduce familyA_primary_fields.mat ed and Cod to 1e-12 of |K|
regressions.S0_adapter: bank COD (g2_sif_cod_banks via adapter) must equal the original g2_sif_cod to 1e-10 of |K|; the upper bank must lie on the +n = (-1,0) side
regressions.S1: g2_trajectory_sif_on_mesh must reproduce the State 1 record (KI_raw, KII_raw, COD) to 1e-12
regressions.S2: g2_trajectory_sif_on_mesh must reproduce REVIEW.sif to 1e-12, and the PR #35 case arrays exactly

uncertainty: unchanged from G2_MATERIAL_POLICY_v1.json uncertainty block (primary U_R with coverage 2 and COD sign; conservative R*(dG_M + dG_H1)); both verdicts reported for every state

steering.frame: theta_MTS in each state's own last-segment frame; the global terminal tangent angle is reported separately
steering.dThetaResolvedIf: |dTheta| > 2*max(|dTheta_COD - dTheta|, |dTheta_4x4 - dTheta|, contour spread of dTheta)
steering.independentRootCheck: bracketed fzero of KI sin(th) + KII (3 cos(th) - 1) = 0 on [-pi/2, pi/2] must agree with g2_mts_direction to 1e-10 rad

evolutionReading.transitionOnlyIf: R-1 changes sign across states with both signs resolved under the primary rule; reported with the conservative verdict alongside
evolutionReading.baselineSeparation: G_H1(s) reported separately; differences of absolute G across states are not attributed to the material

stopScope: a HOLD in one state stops that state and all later stages; earlier PASS states are kept and reported
